title: Conduction
summary: Heat travels through solids from particle to particle. Metals conduct well; wood, plastic and air are insulators.

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 7: Heat Transfer in Nature

objectives: I can describe conduction as heat moving through a material from particle to particle.
I can classify materials as good conductors or insulators of heat.
I can plan a fair test comparing how well materials conduct heat.
misconceptions: Metals are naturally colder than wood (they feel cold because they conduct heat away from your hand).
Heat travels through a spoon because the spoon is ‘made of heat’.
